title: 5.1. A total of 55,473 crimes were committed under the IPC by the Juveniles and youthful offenders during 1983 against 59,345 in 1982 recording a decline of 6.5 per cent in 1983 over 1982. The Juvenile and youthful offenders were responsible for 4.1 per cent of the total IPC cases reported during 1983 against 4.4 per cent. during 1982. The volume of juvenile crime per one lakh of population was 7.7 for 1983 against 8.4 for 1982. Table-30 presents the estimated mid-year population, total cognizable crime under IPC, the total juvenile crime under IPC, percentage of juvenile crime to total cognizable IPC crimes and volume of juvenile crime per lakh of population. The figures would show that the proportion of involvement of juveniles in crime showed a fluctuating trend and ranged between 3.3 to 4.4 per cent during 1973 to 1983. Similarly, the volume of juvenile crime per lakh of population also showed a fluctuating trend and ranged between 6.3 to 8.8 during 1973 to 1983.
